title: Max Rebo Band
description: THE MAX REMO BAND consists of Max on the Red Ball Jett Organ, Droopy McCool on wind, and that irrepressible song stylist with those impossibly far-out lips, Sy Snootles. In this production painting (front) by Ralph McQuarrie, Max and the band play before the denizens of Jabba's palace before journeying to Jabba's sail-barge - the last performance they are to give. Rebo and Snootles were designed by Phil Tippett, McCool by Wesley Seeds.
